_metadata.description: Thin human-default CLI surface, discoverability, and the operator UI console.

requirements.title: Human-default CLI with JSON opt-in
requirements.description: performance-health readiness|audit|lighthouse|benchmark|budget|trend|fleet|startup render useful human output by default using the shared maturity renderer; --json emits the same structure for programmatic consumers. Thin Connect-client wrappers carry no business logic.

validation.notes: CLI tests assert human output without --json and structural JSON parity with --json across the verb set.

requirements.title: CLI verbs discoverable through cli-health
requirements.description: Every verb is registered in cli/manifest.json (each bound to a connect-rpc service/method or listed in omitted[]) and is discoverable through cli-health's CLI→search-hub command index.

validation.notes: Asserts every domain group is registered and the manifest covers every Connect endpoint (bound or omitted).

requirements.title: Audit workbench over real data
requirements.description: The UI audit workbench (pick a scenario → see its tier → run → trace + located findings) is reachable and functional against the Connect RPCs over real data, with loading/error/empty states and accessible navigation landmarks.

validation.notes: Renders the workbench against mocked Connect responses; asserts tier display, run flow, findings list, and loading/error/empty states.

requirements.title: Trend and fleet dashboards
requirements.description: The UI renders the perf-over-time trend view (build time, startup, LCP, component hotspots) and the fleet-performance dashboard (offenders: no budget / slow build / regressed) for humans and meta-optimization.

validation.notes: Renders trend charts and the fleet offender table from mocked data with empty/loading/error states.

requirements.title: Readiness + one-click autofix surface
requirements.description: The UI shows readiness gaps (missing perf-build infra) and offers a one-click autofix (preview → apply) wired to the readiness/autofix RPCs, with a budgets view/edit surface.

validation.notes: Renders readiness gaps and drives preview/apply against mocked autofix responses.
